Interface ImplicitCallContext

public interface ImplicitCallContext
What an ImplicitCallModel needs to know about the analysis that uses it: how methods are looked up, and which methods the analysis follows into. A call graph algorithm passes the same lookup and the same notion of analyzed methods that it uses itself, so that a rule fires exactly where the analysis would not see the implicit call otherwise.

    • isAnalyzed

      boolean isAnalyzed(@NonNull SootMethod method)
      Whether the analysis follows calls into the given method, i.e. it will see the calls in its body. A call graph algorithm answers this for concrete methods that its CallResolver does not exclude.

    • callTargets

      default @NonNull Optional<Set<MethodSignature>> callTargets(@NonNull MethodSignature caller, @NonNull InvokableStmt stmt)
      The methods that the analysis dispatches the call at stmt in caller to, as far as it knows them, e.g. those of the receiver classes it considers instantiated; empty if the analysis does not say. An analysis that finds more targets later asks the model again.
